title: Louis
description: Yoto MYO client — YouTube search and playlist editor
note: Register your Yoto redirect URI on yoto.dev before connecting. Open Louis at your host IP or hostname (not localhost from other devices). Uses host networking so YouTube downloads go out over the host's IPv6 when available; Louis listens on port 4000 of the host unless you change Port. Single instance only.

env.name: LOUIS_YOTO_CLIENT_ID
env.label: Yoto client ID
env.description: Required — public PKCE client ID from yoto.dev

env.name: LOUIS_YOUTUBE_API_KEY
env.label: YouTube API key (optional)
env.description: Recommended for faster search and content filtering

env.name: LOUIS_PORT
env.label: Port
env.description: Host port Louis listens on (host networking). Change only if 4000 is already in use

env.name: LOUIS_COOKIE_SECURE
env.label: Secure OAuth cookies
env.description: Set true only behind HTTPS; leave false for LAN HTTP

env.name: LOUIS_YOTO_REDIRECT_URI
env.label: OAuth redirect URI (optional)
env.description: Leave empty to use the Host you open Louis with
